embed_page.title: Embed Widget
embed_page.subtitle: Add the AI product description widget to your store
embed_page.live_preview_desc: This is a live preview of how the widget will appear on your store.
shopify_steps: Go to your Shopify Admin → Online Store → Themes
Paste the embed code just before the </body> tag
Visit your store to verify the widget appears
salla_steps: Go to your Salla Dashboard → Store Settings
Paste the embed code in the "Footer" section
Visit your store to verify the widget appears
zid_steps: Go to your Zid Dashboard → Store Design
Paste the embed code in the "Body End" field
Visit your store to verify the widget appears
